note: Rewritten from the new-species description in that journal, 1926, the original in English; the original uses the old combination Kalotermes (Glyptotermes) nevermani, now placed in Glyptotermes (the original already uses Glyptotermes as a subgenus). Soldier only, the alate unknown. OCR problems: a few characters (Irazt / I-1.05 / hind tibia) are transcribed as the context requires.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Head pale yellow, darker (yellowish brown) anteriorly, longer than wide, columnar, only slightly wider posteriorly than anteriorly; frons oblique, angularly declined, with a broad circular suture in the middle, the margins of the lateral lobes rounded and slightly rugose, slightly raised; head with several transverse rows of long hairs. Eye spots transparent, large, nearly oval. Postmentum long, its median width about half the greatest anterior width. Mandibles dark reddish brown, pitch black at the tip, wide, narrowing towards the tip, pointed and incurved; left mandible with one pointed marginal tooth near the tip, with an anteriorly situated pointed molar tooth and a wider molar surface; right mandible with a pointed tooth in the middle, the molar surface similar to that of K. (G.) —— Snyder. Antennae pale yellow (darker at the base), 10—12-segmented, usually 11, the segments becoming longer and wider (cuneate) towards the tip, with long hairs; segment 3 short, ring-like, shorter than segment 2 or 4; terminal segment slender, nearly elliptical. Pronotum yellow (margins darker), anterior margin broadly and shallowly concave, posterior margin nearly straight, anterior corners high, the sides narrowing angularly posteriorly; hairs scattered and long. Prosternal process yellow. Legs white with yellow, femora swollen, with long hairs. Abdomen greyish white, each tergite with a row of long hairs at its base, cerci rather long, with styli.

sections.label: Other
sections.text: Measurements: total soldier length 5—6.25 mm; head length including the mandibles 2.5—2.7 mm; head length without the mandibles (to the anterior margin) 1.8—1.9 mm; left mandible length 0.95 mm; pronotum length 0.6—0.7 mm; hind tibia length 0.9 mm; head width (dorsal) 1.2 mm anteriorly, 1.25 mm posteriorly; head height at mid-length 1.2 mm; pronotum width 1—1.05 mm. Type locality the western slope of Irazú Volcano, Costa Rica, at 1500 m altitude; described from 3 soldiers and a nymph, the alate unknown.
